desc: 旧水泥墙与锈铁窗前的褪色胶片灰调女童条纹裙套装展示
leaf: 女童卫衣条纹半裙打底裤春秋套装
name: 锈窗水泥墙女童条纹裙套装款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼立住黑白条纹叠穿的轮廓，承接点击且不带任何文字与道具。
主图一秒法则：用一处主张讲清上衣、条纹半裙与打底裤的叠穿比例，只允许一个卖点。
shots.textZone: 下部氧化铁红横带落一行主张位，右侧切角卡位再落一条短注

shots.intent: 用织纹与罗纹收边的微距替代表述不清的检测数字，让做工自己说话。
把套装放进旧厂房出街场景，让买家代入春秋日常穿搭，用氛围而不是参数打动人。
承接原页的属性滑条与量衣线稿版式，全部刻度、档位与表格单元一律留空待填，消除规格疑虑但不编造数字。
shots.textZone: 三张卡各留一个标题槽，其中一格写 「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 让买家在同一光位下看完正面与背面关系，并留下一个空配色卡位供实际 SKU 填充。
shots.textZone: 顶部石膏横幅留一行色名槽，写 「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 收口去风险：以包边特写与三个空白凭据框承载资质位，绝不生成任何证书内容与编号。
shots.textZone: 下部墨黑场留一行收口槽，写 「{callout_4}」

style.backgroundSystem: a real weathered shell instead of any seamless sweep: one raw cement wall #B7B0A4 as the recurring ground, a chalked plaster band #DCD8CF as the header field, a cool cast-concrete board #C3C8C2 for the flat-lay screen, a deep shadowed concrete variant #8C867B for the stitch macro, and a graphite steel panel #4E5256 reserved for the closing screen; oxidised steel only ever enters as a narrow edge #7E5236, never as full scenery
style.direction: weathered editorial kidswear lookbook shot against a real abandoned-loft concrete shell, faded neutral film tonality with strict infographic control on the specification screens
style.iconSystem: single-weight hairline pictograms drawn as empty clipped-square outline cells in graphite #2C2A27, one oxide brick-red tick #A8412C marking the active slot of the three-rail attribute block, and three blank square seal frames whose centre slots always stay empty; no circular badge, no laurel, no star, no scalloped edge, no certificate border, no triangle page flag
style.lightingSystem: neutral daylight-balanced 5200K north-window light, large soft key from the upper left with a broad bounce on the shadow side, low contrast, one honest contact shadow under every hem and card edge; a sweeping skimming component is allowed only on the two texture screens; no harsh speculars, no coloured gels, no warm golden-hour cast
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent weathered editorial children's apparel lookbook system across the entire image set; fixed palette of raw cement grey #B7B0A4, chalked plaster white #DCD8CF, one oxide brick-red spot #A8412C and graphite ink #2C2A27; every ground is a real weathered shell, never a seamless paper sweep or studio cyclorama; neutral daylight-balanced 5200K north-window key from the upper left with a broad bounce, low contrast, one honest contact shadow, and a sweeping skimming component only on the two texture screens; narrow letterspaced grotesque display capitals for graphic bands plus one light humanist sans for every label, no serif and no handwriting; single-weight hairline pictograms sit in empty clipped-square outline cells and blank square seal frames that always stay unlettered and unfilled; the top, skirt and leggings read as one set at one locked scale; in-image Chinese appears only as bracketed selling-point or callout placeholders inside a declared copy zone; every worn body is a generic child cropped below the neck or seen from behind; no substitute backdrop, no fifth hue, no mixed typefaces, no face, no digits on rails, grids or seals, no invented certification.
noDrift: no seamless paper sweep, no studio cyclorama, no gradient wall and no furnished interior may replace the weathered cement-and-plaster shell
no fifth hue and no candy pastel, lemon yellow, sky blue or warm orange accent outside the single oxide brick-red spot #A8412C
no identifiable child face, eye or mouth in any screen; every worn frame is cropped below the neck or shown from behind
no digits, units, ranges, range-label words or filled marker stops on the attribute rails, the measurement line drawings, the grid cells or the seal frames
no certificate, award, score, lab figure, standard code or invented certification artwork on the closing screen
no wall slogan, no decorative filler paragraph, no quotation-mark ornament and no foreign-language display line lifted from the reference set
style.presentationRules: the top, the striped skirt and the leggings always read as one set at one locked scale, hero scale never shifting more than five percent between screens; the rectangular print placement on the chest is named structurally, kept square-on, unobstructed and never redrawn; every worn frame uses a generic child body cropped below the neck or seen from behind, never an identifiable face; rails, line drawings and grid cells stay unfilled
style.surfaceSystem: single weathered cement wall #B7B0A4 for worn frames, cool cast-concrete board #C3C8C2 under every card and line drawing, chalked card stock #EFECE5 as the paper of all insets, one matte graphite steel step form #4E5256 as the only seating object; no wood, no rattan, no marble, no turf, no painted studio floor; garment faces stay flat, lint-free and uncreased
style.typography: one narrow letterspaced grotesque display capital set used only as a graphic band that never carries a fact, plus one light humanist sans for every Chinese and Latin label; headline 30-46pt, subline 15-19pt, label 11-13pt, per-screen copy budget under 50 characters; in-image Chinese appears only as bracketed selling-point or callout placeholders inside a declared copy zone; no serif, no brush script, no handwriting, no Korean or Japanese display characters
